title: Little Adventurer Treasure Hunt
description:
In the world of "Little Adventurer's Treasure Hunt," help alien friends who have crash-landed on Earth to find spaceship parts and embark on a fun and lighthearted treasure hunt!

Game Features• Whimsical hand-drawn art style

• Meticulously designed and diverse levels

• Assist those in need to earn rewards

• Moderate puzzle-solving with carefully crafted Easter eggs

• Hidden cats in achievements waiting to be discovered

PS: Maybe the target is in the most obvious spot!

If you encounter any bugs, please contact us at 101063791@qq.com.
description_short: "Little Adventurer Treasure Hunt" is a game focused on object-finding. The main storyline revolves around helping alien friends who have been forced to land on Earth due to an "accident", assisting them in searching for scattered items, parts, and their lost crew members across various locations.
